explanation: Shows how V8 calculates interrupt budgets based on invocation counts and bytecode length. Key thresholds: invocation_count_for_maglev (default 1000), invocation_count_for_turbofan (default 3000), invocation_count_for_maglev_with_delay (600), invocation_count_for_early_optimization, and invocation_count_for_osr. These thresholds multiplied by bytecode length determine when optimization interrupts fire. During fuzzing, short-running scripts may never reach these thresholds, preventing optimization and exploration of optimized code paths. Profile-guided optimization with cached_tiering_decision (kDelayMaglev, kEarlyMaglev, etc.) further influences timing.
